meta.via: Figma file via the Figma connector, after the 30 October update: Brand collection (Business News, Defence Economy and Orion modes) holds colours and typefaces; Type scale collection (Desktop and Mobile modes) holds sizes; desktop and mobile text styles merged into one set of 32.

tokens.name: bn-brand-primary
tokens.usage: Primary brand blue. Primary button fill, links, icon colour on light grounds, focus and selected borders. White text on it is 5.2:1. As text it reads 5.2:1 on white and 4.57:1 on bn-bg-blue, but only 4.35:1 on bn-bg-grey (below 4.5:1 for small text). Figma variable `bn/brand/primary` (Brand collection). Defence Economy uses the Business News value until its own is chosen.

tokens.name: bn-brand-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of primary buttons and controls. Figma variable `bn/brand/primary/hover` (Brand collection). Defence Economy uses the Business News value until its own is chosen.

tokens.name: bn-brand-white
tokens.usage: White surfaces, and text and icons on bn-brand-primary or bn-brand-dark. Figma variable `bn/brand/white` (Brand collection).

tokens.name: bn-brand-accent
tokens.usage: Marketing yellow for calls to action and highlights. Use dark text on it (bn-fonts-headings), never white. Figma variable `bn/brand/accent` (Brand collection). Defence Economy uses the Business News value until its own is chosen.

tokens.name: bn-brand-bright
tokens.usage: Bright marketing blue for accents on dark grounds. Not for body text on white (3.0:1). Figma variable `bn/brand/bright` (Brand collection). Defence Economy uses the Business News value until its own is chosen.

tokens.name: bn-fonts-headings
tokens.usage: Headings and strong text on white, bn-bg-grey and bn-bg-blue. Figma variable `bn/fonts/headings` (Brand collection). Defence Economy: #0d1f3c, 15.78:1 on its canvas.

tokens.name: bn-fonts-links
tokens.usage: Link and label text on white and pale backgrounds. Figma variable `bn/fonts/links` (Brand collection). Defence Economy: #0d1f3c, 15.78:1 on its canvas.

tokens.name: bn-fonts-body
tokens.usage: Body copy on white (7.45:1), bn-bg-grey and bn-bg-blue. Figma variable `bn/fonts/body` (Brand collection). Defence Economy: #40464f, 9.14:1 on its canvas.

tokens.name: bn-bg-blue
tokens.usage: Pale blue background for selected, subscribed and highlighted surfaces, and round icon buttons. Figma variable `bn/bg/blue` (Brand collection).

tokens.name: bn-bg-grey
tokens.usage: Pale grey background for neutral surfaces, bookmark and share buttons, hover of destructive buttons. Figma variable `bn/bg/grey` (Brand collection). Defence Economy: #eceae6 (its "Background 1"). bn-brand-primary text on it is 4.33:1, under 4.5:1 for small text.

tokens.name: bn-brand-dark
tokens.usage: Dark navy for headers, footers and dark panels. White text on it. Figma variable `bn/brand/dark` (Brand collection). Defence Economy uses the Business News value until its own is chosen.

tokens.name: bn-system-yellow
tokens.usage: System warning and "on hold" status marks. Not for text on white (2.17:1). Figma variable `bn/system/yellow` (Brand collection).

tokens.name: bn-system-green-deco
tokens.usage: Success and positive status marks (icons, borders). Not for text on white (2.49:1). Figma variable `bn/system/green/deco` (Brand collection).

tokens.name: bn-system-green-bg
tokens.usage: Background behind success messages. Figma variable `bn/system/green/bg` (Brand collection).

tokens.name: bn-system-red-deco
tokens.usage: Error and destructive marks (icons, borders); 3.62:1 on white, so not for small text. Figma variable `bn/system/red/deco` (Brand collection).

tokens.name: bn-system-red-text
tokens.usage: Error and destructive text on white (5.4:1) or bn-system-red-bg (4.59:1). Figma variable `bn/system/red/text` (Brand collection).

tokens.name: bn-system-red-bg
tokens.usage: Background behind errors and the destructive button. Figma variable `bn/system/red/bg` (Brand collection).

tokens.name: bn-bg-canvas
tokens.usage: Page background. White for Business News; a warm off-white for Defence Economy. Figma variable `bn/bg/canvas` (Brand collection).

tokens.name: bn-content-money
tokens.usage: Defence Economy content category: Money. As text, 4.6:1 on canvas, 3.99:1 on bn-bg-grey (below 4.5:1 for small text). Business News has no content categories, so it points at bn-brand-primary as a placeholder. Figma variable `bn/content/money` (Brand collection).

tokens.name: bn-content-infra
tokens.usage: Defence Economy content category: Infra. As text, 4.97:1 on canvas, 4.31:1 on bn-bg-grey (below 4.5:1 for small text). Business News has no content categories, so it points at bn-brand-primary as a placeholder. Figma variable `bn/content/infra` (Brand collection).

tokens.name: bn-content-tech
tokens.usage: Defence Economy content category: Tech. As text, 9.8:1 on canvas. Business News has no content categories, so it points at bn-brand-primary as a placeholder. Figma variable `bn/content/tech` (Brand collection).

tokens.name: bn-content-work
tokens.usage: Defence Economy content category: Work. As text, 5.26:1 on canvas, 4.56:1 on bn-bg-grey. Business News has no content categories, so it points at bn-brand-primary as a placeholder. Figma variable `bn/content/work` (Brand collection).

tokens.name: bn-content-policy
tokens.usage: Defence Economy content category: Policy. As text, 13.04:1 on canvas. Business News has no content categories, so it points at bn-brand-primary as a placeholder. Figma variable `bn/content/policy` (Brand collection).

tokens.name: bn-space-xs
tokens.usage: Tight gaps between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: bn-space-sm
tokens.usage: Small gaps inside controls and between tags. Gaps that were 10px in Figma now use this step.

tokens.name: bn-space-md
tokens.usage: Standard horizontal padding in buttons (bound in DT_Button) and card padding.

tokens.name: bn-space-lg
tokens.usage: Gaps between groups within a section.

tokens.name: bn-space-xl
tokens.usage: Space between sections.

tokens.name: bn-radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, follow and toggle controls, checkboxes and search. Figma variable `bn/radius/sm` (Global Radii).

tokens.name: bn-radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills and circles: tags, tag filters, action links, round icon buttons and radio dots. Figma variable `bn/radius/full` (Global Radii).

brands.note: Type per brand. The type groups above are Business News. Defence Economy changes only what is listed here; Orion uses Business News values. CSS: add data-brand="defence-economy" to <html>.
